basic_info.description: Soaring vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light create a sense of airy elegance in this Cow Hollow condo, beautifully framed by stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the bay. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas are ideal for entertaining, featuring wall-to-wall windows that invite the outdoors in. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets over the bridge while preparing dinner in a chef-inspired kitchen with bar seating and high-end appliances, including a Viking range. Step out to your private view terrace or unwind in the shared yard with BBQ area, ideal for outdoor dining and relaxation. Inside, cozy fireplaces in both the living room and primary suite add warmth and charm on foggy days. The bedrooms are spacious and filled with light, offering large windows, serene views, and ample closet space. The primary suite boasts an expansive walk-in closet, while the other two bedrooms feature custom built-in cabinetry. Both full baths have a spa-like feel, the primary offering a large shower and the guest bathroom offering a shower over bath. Additional conveniences include generous storage throughout, in-unit laundry closet with stacked Bosch washer/dryer, an exclusive-use storage unit, and stackable two-car garage parking.
